## The problem

What is painful or missing today? A concrete workflow is more useful than a general wish.

## What you would like

The behavior or interface you want, including command shape if you have one (`ai-devkit ...`).

## Why this belongs in AI DevKit

A short note on who it helps, and whether it is a core control-plane concern (agents, memory, skills, channels, setup) or something that could stay as a skill or an external tool.

## Possible approach

If you already have an idea, sketch it. This is optional.

## Extra context

Links, prior issues, or examples from other tools.
